title: Agent Zero - Full BoTZ Access
description: Complete access to all PMOVES BoTZ tools via MCP Gateway. Enables Agent Zero to orchestrate workflows, manage infrastructure, execute code, persist knowledge, and leverage agent skills.
whenToUse: Managing Hostinger VPS instances and DNS
Storing and retrieving knowledge across sessions
Learning new capabilities via agent skills
instructions: 1) Route all tool calls through MCP Gateway (port 2091) for unified access.
2) Use skill_search to find relevant skills before attempting unfamiliar tasks.
3) Load skill instructions with skill_get and follow them step-by-step.
4) Store task context, outcomes, and reasoning traces in cipher-memory.
5) Use n8n-agent to automate recurring tasks with workflows.
6) Use hostinger tools for VPS management (start/stop/restart), DNS records, and domain settings.
7) Use e2b sandbox for safe code execution when testing or running user code.
8) Use vl-sentinel for visual guidance on UI/image-related tasks.
9) Use docling for document parsing and table extraction.
10) Check cipher-memory for past solutions before attempting new approaches.

gateway.description: All tools accessed via unified MCP Gateway
